Five small round patties sit on a square plate roughly 24 cm across. Each patty is about 4.5 cm wide and about 1.5 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 24 cm³ per patty, so with a density of about 0.8 they weigh roughly 15–20 g each. Five patties come to about 85 g.

They look like small baked or fried bites, possibly falafel, a vegetable fritter, or a mini quiche or egg muffin. I'll treat them as savory vegetable and grain fritters at about 200 kcal/100 g.
